Title: MemorySmith.Agent — BuildOrigin Value Object (TSK-0103)
Content:
## Overview

BuildOrigin (Agent.Planning/Goals/BuildOrigin.cs) is a sealed record value object representing a resolved build origin with its provenance. Consolidated from three nullable coordinate fields (OriginX, OriginY, OriginZ) and BuildOriginSource enum previously stored as separate properties on BuildGoal (TSK-0103, absorbing TSK-0098).

## Record Structure

```csharp
public sealed record BuildOrigin(int X, int Y, int Z, BuildOriginSource Source);
```

## Key Design Decisions

- Atomic: all three coordinates must be present. Partial coordinates are rejected.
- Self-documenting: Source tracks HOW the origin was determined
- No sentinel overloading: missing origin is represented as null, not (0,0,0)
- String? type on Source values for flexibility

## BuildOriginSource Enum (defined in BuildGoal.cs)

| Value | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| Explicit | Player explicitly provided coordinates (via chat or REST API) |
| PlayerPosition | Derived from the bot's current position as a positional fallback |
| AutoScanned | Found via FindFlatArea or automatic scanning (warning logged before building) |

## Factory Method

BuildOrigin.FromNullable(int? x, int? y, int? z, BuildOriginSource source = BuildOriginSource.AutoScanned):
- Returns null when any coordinate is null (prevents partial origin ambiguity)
- Used by BuildGoalRequest constructor to safely handle optional coords from IntentDraft

## Usage Flow

1. IntentManager.TryBuildGoal(IntentDraft): calls BuildOrigin.FromNullable(draft.X, draft.Y, draft.Z)
2. If all three coords present → BuildOrigin with UserSpecified source
3. If any coord missing → null origin (agent auto-resolves)
4. BuildGoalRequest stores BuildOrigin? → GoalFactory creates BuildGoal
5. BuildGoal.Origin property exposes the BuildOrigin for the decomposer
